```{r load libraries}
library(readxl)
library(SingleR)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(SCpubr)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
```

Run the analysis for the first replicate of the dataset, SMRU1
```{r assign stages singleR, sample: SMRU1}
# upload reference data to R
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <-
  read_excel("/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/data/original_file/Zhu_SciReps_2016.xls",
    sheet = "SMRU1"
  )

# upload PVP01 orthologs
PVX_PVP01_orthologs <-
  readxl::read_excel("/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/data/original_file/GenesByOrthologs_Summary.xlsx")

# process and tidy data
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- as.data.frame(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- left_join(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1,
  PVX_PVP01_orthologs,
  by = c("Gid" = "InputOrtholog")
)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- drop_na(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1[, c(2:9)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1) <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1$GeneID
Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1 <- Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1[, c(1:7)]

rownames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)
counts <- as.matrix(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)

# convert to summarized experiment
IDC_cycle <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assay = SimpleList(logcounts = counts),
  colData = colnames(Zhu_HiDef_PVX_IDC_timecourse_1)
)
IDC_cycle$X <- NULL

# upload seurat object
pv.combined.all <- readRDS("/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/data/original_file/Pv.all.12.Jan2025.rds")

# convert Seurat object to single-cell experiment object for SingleR mapping
sce.all <- as.SingleCellExperiment(DietSeurat(pv.combined.all,
  layers = "data", assays = "RNA"
))

# Run SingleR
pred.IDC.all <- SingleR(
  test = sce.all, ref = IDC_cycle, assay.type.test = 1,
  labels = colnames(IDC_cycle)
)

plotDeltaDistribution(pred.IDC.all, ncol = 3)


# sopheap identify IDC time
pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels <- as.numeric(pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels)
pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels <- case_when(
  pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels >= 0 & pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels < 18 ~ "Ring",
  pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels >= 18 & pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels < 30 ~ "Trophozoite",
  pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels >= 30 & pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels < 46 ~ "Schizont",
  pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels >= 46 & pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels <= 48 ~ "Merozoite",
  TRUE ~ NA
)


# Add SingleR annotations to Seurat object
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- pred.IDC.all$pruned.labels


# Replace NA vaues with "99"
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- pv.combined.all$IDC.pred %>% replace_na("99")


# # Convert annotations to factor and relevel

#   levels = c("Ring", "Trophozoite", "Schizont", "Merozoite", "99")
# )
```

Identify cells that are 'potential gametocytes'
```{r identify gametocytes}
femaleGams <- c(
  "PVP01-1207200", "PVP01-0616100", "PVP01-1119300", "PVP01-1465500", "PVP01-1259400", "PVP01-1441000", "PVP01-0702600",
  "PVP01-1306800", "PVP01-0946800", "PVP01-0517400", "PVP01-1027600", "PVP01-1003000", "PVP01-1143200",
  "PVP01-1017500", "PVP01-1024300", "PVP01-0806000", "PVP01-1240300", "PVP01-0603600", "PVP01-0712800"
)

maleGams <- c("PVP01-1262200", "PVP01-0530800", "PVP01-1412100", "PVP01-1025600", "PVP01-1266500", "PVP01-1229400")

pv.combined.all <- AddModuleScore(
  object = pv.combined.all,
  features = list(c(femaleGams)),
  name = "femaleGams_module_score"
)
pv.combined.all <- AddModuleScore(
  object = pv.combined.all,
  features = list(c(maleGams)),
  name = "maleGams_module_score"
)

Plot_Density_Custom(
  seurat_object = pv.combined.all, features = "maleGams_module_score1",
  custom_palette = PurpleAndYellow()
)
```

```{r}
# this code added by Sopheap
threshold_male <- 0.3
threshold_female <- 0.2

gametocyte_cells <- WhichCells(pv.combined.all,
  expression = maleGams_module_score1 > threshold_male | femaleGams_module_score1 > threshold_female
)

pv.combined.all$IDC.pred <- as.character(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred)
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2 <- as.character(pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2)

pv.combined.all$IDC.pred[gametocyte_cells] <- "Gametocyte"
pv.combined.all$IDC.pred.SMRU2[gametocyte_cells] <- "Gametocyte"

VlnPlot(pv.combined.all, features = c("PVP01-1207300"), group.by = "IDC.pred")

Idents(pv.combined.all) <- "IDC.pred"

ring_markers <- FindMarkers(pv.combined.all, ident.1 = "Ring", min.pct = 0.25)

VlnPlot(pv.combined.all, features = c("PVP01-0532900", "PVP01-1033600"), group.by = "IDC.pred")

saveRDS(pv.combined.all, "/srv/baia/prj/pvsca/data/original_file/Pv.all.12.Jan2025_os.rds")
```
